name: Secondary Position Demo — Target / Mosaic Step-Down
note_description: A worst-of autocall on Target and Mosaic, issued 15 January 2025 for three years, quarterly. This config is a POSITION rather than a subscription: it was bought on the secondary market on 20 January 2026 at 86% of nominal plus 1.25% accrued, a year and four observations into the note's life. The worst-of has traded below the initial level throughout, so it never reached an autocall rung and is still alive, and the memory feature has caught up the coupons missed below the 70% barrier. Because the note is held, the app models what is LEFT of it — the projection runs from today to the original January 2028 maturity, opens at the worst-of's current level rather than at 100%, prices only the observations still to come, and measures every return from the settlement date on the 87.25% actually paid. Coupons that fixed before settlement belonged to the seller and are excluded; the ones banked since are part of the position's return. Clear the settlement date to see the same term sheet valued as a hypothetical note issued today at par.
